conbody.note: Tip shown on the board itself: assign a card to an agent and drag it to To Do to launch the agent.

ul.li: When you move a card assigned to an agent into To Do, an agent run is enqueued for that card (skipped if a live run is already attached). Only human moves trigger this — the automatic card moves that track run progress don't.
A pulsing blue dot on a card means a run is live (queued, claimed, or running). While a run is live the card is locked — it can't be dragged until the run finishes.
The agent's progress and comments land back on the card's activity feed.

A chat is not a task. Talking to the assistant, or typing a prompt to an agent with ▶ Launch run, puts no card on the board: the run is on the Runs page. A card is something you assigned; an automation or a schedule that starts an agent on a project still gets one, so its work is tracked.
